title: Psalm 4.23 and 4.24 crashes on enum const used in php 8.1 Annotations

Script bin/psalm handling the psalm event returned with error code 1


How to reproduce problem:
1. In symfony App, create enum with public const like this:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\S;

enum S: string
{
    public const COMPANY_NOT_EXISTS_VALUE = 'COMPANY_NOT_EXISTS';

    case COMPANY_NOT_EXISTS = self::COMPANY_NOT_EXISTS_VALUE;
}

2. use enum constant in annotation
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\S;

#[AsTaggedItem(S::COMPANY_NOT_EXISTS_VALUE)]
class W
{
}

3. run psalm and it crashes with mentioned error
